summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Cango Inc., a Cayman Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer, announcing an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for June 24, 2026. The meeting seeks shareholder approval for two proposals: a share consolidation with a ratio up to 10:1 (rounded down, no fractional shares) and adoption of amended articles to reflect the consolidation. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR. This is a routine shareholder meeting to authorize a capital structure adjustment (reverse stock split) often used to regain compliance with listing standards; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
